title: When the Vector Wakes
author: Coral Hartwell
blurb: Noor Voss, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
